context_requirements: Cells must be actively proliferating and dependent on de novo DNA synthesis for S-phase progression.
Intact p53 pathway for robust transcriptional DNA damage response; p53-mutant lines may show weaker or delayed induction.
Ribosome biogenesis and translation must be active, as the annotated targets include ribosomal proteins and NHP2L1.
No requirement for specific receptor expression; response is largely lineage-independent.
falsifiers: No decrease in S-phase or proliferation-related genes (e.g., MCM3, PCNA, RFC2, RFC5) at 6 h or 24 h in any responsive line.
No induction of p53 targets (e.g., CDKN1A, GADD45A, MDM2, RRM2B) at 6 h or 24 h in any line.
Strong and selective upregulation of ribosomal protein genes without any DNA synthesis or p53 response.
No difference in transcriptional response between 6 h and 24 h across all lines, suggesting no DNA synthesis inhibition.
Response only in one cell line and absent in all others, contradicting broad activity.
